# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_J_TOP3_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to quantify the baseline engine's edge capture and Sharpe ratio on the three J winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) using walk-forward out-of-sample and real-fills validation. This will establish a ground-truth baseline for evaluating future strategy changes.

## Mechanism

For each of the three winner dates, we will run a walk-forward OOS backtest using all prior data up to the day's open, applying the current engine logic (as defined in heartbeat.md and params.json). Separately, we will replay the day using cached real OPRA fills to measure slippage and fill quality vs. BS simulation. Edge capture for winners is summed; Sharpe is computed from the equity curve of the OOS period (or from the three-day sample if insufficient data).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ account required to trade qty=28 (ITM-2 0DTE) at ~$1.00 entry premium; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Analysis limited to 3 winner days (small n=3); high overfit risk; not representative of full J set or regime.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward OOS not yet performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA replay not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a loser day where engine incurs large loss; max drawdown measured over OOS window; blow-up scenario if engine takes excessive leverage on adverse gap.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires full P&L breakdown to compute top-5 days % of total.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>

We require: gym test suite PASS, walk-forward OOS with Sharpe ≥ 0.70 and profit factor > 1.0 on the three winner days, real-fills validation showing <20% deviation from BS simulation on entry/exit prices for top 3 J days.

2 / 10 -- No backtest data available; purely speculative until OOS and real-fills validation are completed.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not propose a change to the engine; it is a measurement baseline. It does not conflict with any existing candidate in the leaderboard. It may inform future candidates by providing accurate J-day P&L figures.
